title: AUTHOR AS CHARACTER AND NARRATOR: DECONSTRUCTING PERSONAL NARRATIVES FROM THE r/AmITheAsshole REDDIT COMMUNITY
reasoning: The paper focuses on deconstructing personal narratives involving moral dilemmas and conflicts. It aims to identify linguistic features that correlate with final moral judgments (e.g., 'You’re the Asshole' vs. 'Not the Asshole') within an online community, thereby investigating the presentation of moral values and the construction of moral judgments.
